ja.description:
神器をささげる
(新しい神器を授かる)
ja.note: 終末の時以降、捨てるはささげるに置き換わる。

en.note: After the Apocalypse, Discard is replaced into Sacrifice.

methods: fv.fq/fF complete fresh/current-owner operation-widget selection (player drawing,hand repaint,DOM/control construction stubbed)
ld actual zero-cost trade short circuit

adapter_boundary.threshold: Match accepts null or nonnegative safe threshold;raw negative client examples are broader renderer domain,not accepted Match inputs
adapter_boundary.operation: local canonical replacement:normal discard before threshold,sacrifice after;physical selectedtokens exclude UI operation0/model2
adapter_boundary.selection: visible predicate;no weapons/revive/attractDanger;usedMC allowed;compatible Dream only;Flash main has no one-card limit
adapter_boundary.execution: local all physical selections erased,no retention/MP/ability triggers;one deferred gift per copy;ordinary main schedule and confusion launch debit;no automatic25percent devil/cascade

conclusions: The real client gbw predicate is nonnull threshold andgf>=threshold. Snapshot decoder takes integer threshold else null,so0/negative integers compare too;the settings picker only offersnull,1,50,75,100,150. Server acceptance of raw other thresholds is not established.

Current-owner fF creates a token0 operation widget with model2 when gbw is true,otherwise model1. It is an operation outside the physical inventory,not an owned sacrificemodel. A fresh rebuild updates currentGF and then selects the operation;the existing board threshold was initialized at construction and isnot reassigned by fv.fq.

Sacrifice/discard append uses face gL category/ability:weapons andrevive/attractDanger are excluded,used miracles and207 can be selected. Flash restriction is only in the response branch,not main multi-selection. Raw incompatible fake probes are outside the current compatible-mask subset.

Actual submit requires at least one selected physical item,then sendsitemIds [0,...physicaltokens]. Selected used or unused miracles cost0 because ld short-circuits on the leading sacrifice/discard operation. NoMP/CP allocation or chosen gift/devil is sent.

The actual ed helper erases every selected physical copy for sacrifice,including used miracles,and creates one empty placeholder for each. Discard erases without placeholders. It doesnot execute the goodsabilities or retain sacrificed miracles.

The following useAttackItems receiver removes used-miracle public entries via e7 ratherthan hF retention. The separate sacrifice receiver only animates the supplied selected model column;it doesnot generate ordeliver gifts.
limitations: Deferred gift quantities,actual server refusal before orafterApocalypse,random gift model/compatibleDream draws,25percent devil interrupts,replacementchain,turncount,GF advancement,disease tick,guardian opportunities,death/revival,cutoff and user timeout are not proven by these display helpers.

The local runtime canonical discard/sacrifice gate and deferred1gift perphysicalcopy are explicit adapter contracts. The raw submit itself doesnot re-run eu or test gbw;forcing an invalid selected array directly into submit can bypassordinary UI selection and isnot proof of authoritative legality.
Fakeprioritized eligibility doesnot establish how the official server handles true-model incompatibility. Current compatible Dream classes deliberately preserve UIrole/ability eligibility.

Fresh-state tests stub player/hand painting and final control visuals,not decoder/GF/threshold/currentowner gates. Item tests stub widget construction/highlight/layout/animations,but actual physical cleanup,used-pane deletion,dispatch andpayload construction rununchanged.
No sourcebundle is redistributed. No network,account,DOM,timer,Dart app startup or backendconnection runs.
